description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'EntityDatatableCheckAlreadyExistsException' used within the Fineract project to indicate duplicate datatable check entries for a specific entity. It extends 'AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException' and provides constructors to create instances with detailed context about the duplication.
